answer: Written in a clipped, no filler register, it stays short. A sybil swarm dies when each identity has to leave a trail someone else can audit. Reaching the inlet of a payout therefore requires sustained, checkable labour rather than a crowd of fresh keys. The design leans on web-of-trust with decaying edges, unlocked only after continuous uptime, quorum must span unrelated subnetworks. A bridge of per-task receipts records who did what, and the juniper of that record is inspected by auditors who gain nothing from passing it.
